data.name: Hotel Los Españoles Plus
data.address: Av. Sta. María 2828, 7520423 Providencia, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
Steps from the U.S. Embassy, this upscale hotel is a 7-minute stroll from the Costanera Center shopping mall and 8.4 km from Zoológico Nacional de Chile.
Modern rooms with mountain views have free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs with cable channels, plus desks and minifridges. Upgraded rooms add whirlpool tubs, while suites provide living areas with pull-out sofas.
Fee hot breakfast and parking are offered. There's a fitness center and a steam room, plus a rooftop pool with a hot tub. Additional amenities include a lounge bar, a restaurant and a coffee shop, along with a business center and meeting facilities.
